clues.text: Refusing comfort after seeing Joseph's bloodied robe, Jacob said he would go down there mourning for his son.
When the ground split open in the wilderness, Korah's men went down into it alive with all they owned.
Praying inside the great fish, Jonah said he called out from its belly and God heard his voice.
David trusted that God would not abandon his soul to it, nor let His Holy One see decay.
Through the prophet Hosea, God promised to ransom His people from its power and asked where its sting was.
After falling ill, King Hezekiah wrote that in the prime of his life he must pass through its gates.
A psalmist, unable to flee God's presence, said that even if he made his bed there, God would be there.
